Text:
# BRAIN ABSCESS WITH PSEUDOMONAS SPP.

Prior to beginning antimicrobial therapy, when possible, computed topographic (CT) - guided aspiration or surgery should be performed to obtain abscess material for determination of infectious pathogen. Adjust antimicrobial regimen to optimize therapy based on pathogen once isolated.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for a total duration of 6-8 weeks

---

References:

- Brouwer et al. N Engl J Med, 2014, 371(5)447-56
- Mandell chapter: Brain abscess
- Up-to-Date Article: Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections of the eye, ear, urinary tract, gastrointestinal tract and central nervous system
Therapy:
Preferred:

Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h ($$) R

Alternative:

Assessment of beta-lactam reaction

Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h ($$) R,O
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU BRN ABSC PSEUDOMONAS SPP.
